extra_quotes: The electrical transport was measured using a Physical Property Measurement System (14 T-Dynacool PPMS, Quantum Design) and a pulsed high magnetic field facility (Wuhan National High Magnetic Field Center).
Standard four-probe method was used to measure MR or Hall resistance.
For the low-carrier-density B3 samples, SdH oscillations become undetectable due to the heavily depleted 3D Fermi surface.
